description: Headline numbers for Proof of Agent mainnet in one call: supply, circulating vs locked, holders, Agents, the open epoch, the last close, open swap offers and chain height, with data freshness. Use it first to orient, or to answer 'how big is the network right now'. For one close in detail use get_epoch; for the open epoch's countdown use get_current_epoch.
name: get_network_summary
title: Network summary
